title: 第23章 太阳之星重创叶峰第24章 母的见到公的可就不灵了
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: “我刚刚没听错吧？
如烟妹妹竟然在徐墨面前自称奴婢，还叫他少爷！”
他声音颤抖，似乎有些不敢相信眼前所发生的一切。
要知道，在他心里，柳如烟可是一个心地善良，单纯可爱的女孩子，可以说是白月光般的存在。
他也一直对其敬爱有加，两人相处这十几年来，他从未对她做过任何出格之举。
可是此刻，他却看到自己的白月光，在一个男人面前自称奴婢，这让他的道心顿时有些炸裂。
而徐墨也通过阵法，将叶峰的反应看在眼里，但是他觉得这还远远不够，所以！
徐墨直接起身，缓缓走到柳如烟面前，伸手摸着柳如烟滑嫩的脸蛋，笑着说道，“如烟，你的小脸可真嫩啊。”
徐墨，老子要杀了你！”
叶峰见此，顿时怒火喷涌，双眼变得血红无比，整个人犹如一头择人噬人的猛兽般。
在叶峰心里，柳如烟早已是他的禁脔，他绝不允许除他以外的男人，触碰柳如烟。
可是现在，徐墨竟然直接伸手揉捏柳如烟的俏脸，要知道纵然是身为柳如烟青梅竹马的他，也从未与她有过这般亲密的举动啊！
这怎么能让叶峰不愤怒。
“峰儿，你一定要冷静，别冲动啊！”
林清音自然也将这一切看在了眼里，赶忙劝说道。
叶峰紧咬牙关，双拳被捏得嘎嘎作响，但他也知晓，此刻一点要冷静。
于是叶峰深呼一口气，平复了下内心愤怒的情绪，然而下一刻，徐墨的声音再次响起。
“如烟，我现在的火气很大，你说应该怎么办呢～”
闻言，叶峰刚平复好的情绪被再度点燃，他死死盯着徐墨，如果眼神能杀人的话，估计徐墨已经死了成千上万次了。
徐墨，他竟敢对如烟妹妹说出此等虎狼之词，实在是不可饶恕！
不过，如烟妹妹应该不会同意吧？一定不会！
叶峰抬起头，双眼通红的看向柳如烟。
然而让叶峰意外的是，面对此等虎狼之词，柳如烟不仅没有恼怒，反而俏脸通红的看着徐墨。
“那就让奴婢给主人消消火吧。”
话落的瞬间，叶峰如遭雷击，整个人好似失去了灵魂，眼神空洞的直接瘫倒在地。
“不可能，这不是真的！
如烟妹妹怎么会答应帮徐墨干那种事呢！
我不相信！”
叶峰不停地摇头，声音中满是不可置信，一时间，只觉得柳如烟是那么的陌生。
同时也感觉自己头发痒痒的，好像凭空多了什么东西。
就在这时，柳如烟开始褪去外衣，然后缓缓靠近徐墨，蹲下准备干着什么的时候。
看到这里，叶峰彻底崩溃了。
压制许久的怒火彻底爆发，他不顾林清音的劝阻，猛地暴起，冲着徐墨大吼。
“徐墨，你他娘欺人太甚！”
content_en:
"Did I hear correctly just now?
Sister Ruyan actually called herself a slave in front of Xu Mo and called him young master! "
His voice was trembling, as if he couldn't believe what was happening in front of him.
You know, in his heart, Liu Ruyan is a kind-hearted, innocent and lovely girl, who can be said to be like a white moonlight.
He has always respected and loved her. In the more than ten years they have been together, he has never done anything out of the ordinary to her.
But at this moment, he saw his Bai Yueguang calling himself a slave in front of a man, which made his Taoist heart burst.
And Xu Mo also used the formation to see Ye Feng's reaction, but he felt that this was not enough, so!
Xu Mo stood up directly, walked slowly to Liu Ruyan, stretched out his hand to touch Liu Ruyan's smooth and tender face, and said with a smile, "Ruyan, your little face is so tender."
"Ah!
Xu Mo, I want to kill you! "
Seeing this, Ye Feng suddenly burst into anger, his eyes became extremely blood-red, and his whole body was like a ferocious beast that chooses and devours people.
In Ye Feng's heart, Liu Ruyan has long been his forbidden love, and he will never allow men other than him to touch Liu Ruyan.
But now, Xu Mo actually stretched out his hand to squeeze Liu Ruyan's pretty face. You know, even though he was Liu Ruyan's childhood sweetheart, he had never been so intimate with her!
How could this make Ye Feng not angry.
"Feng'er, you must calm down and don't be impulsive!"
Lin Qingyin naturally saw all this and hurriedly persuaded her.
Ye Feng gritted his teeth and his fists were clenched, but he also knew that he had to stay calm at this moment.
So Ye Feng took a deep breath to calm down the anger in his heart, but the next moment, Xu Mo's voice sounded again.
"Ruyan, I'm very angry right now, what do you think I should do~"
Hearing this, Ye Feng's calmed down emotions were reignited. He stared at Xu Mo. If eyes could kill, Xu Mo would probably have died thousands of times.
Xu Mo, how dare he say such cruel words to sister Ruyan, it is really unforgivable!
However, Sister Ruyan probably won’t agree, right? Definitely not!
Ye Feng raised his head and looked at Liu Ruyan with red eyes.
However, what surprised Ye Feng was that when faced with such harsh words, Liu Ruyan not only did not get angry, but instead looked at Xu Mo with a red face.
"Then let me help my master extinguish the fire."
The moment he finished speaking, Ye Feng felt as if he had been struck by lightning. He seemed to have lost his soul and collapsed to the ground with empty eyes.
"No way, it's not true!
How could sister Ruyan agree to help Xu Mo do that kind of thing!
I don't believe it! "
Ye Feng kept shaking his head, his voice full of disbelief. For a moment, he felt that Liu Ruyan was so strange.
At the same time, I also felt that my hair was itching, as if something had appeared out of thin air.
At this moment, Liu Ruyan began to take off his coat, then slowly approached Xu Mo, squatting down to do something.
Seeing this, Ye Feng completely collapsed.
The anger that had been suppressed for a long time completely exploded. Regardless of Lin Qingyin's dissuasion, he suddenly burst out and yelled at Xu Mo.
"Xu Mo, you fucking bully me too much!"
